# Helm Terminal

> AI-powered financial intelligence terminal for retail investors.

Helm Terminal provides institutional-grade portfolio analysis, AI stock analysis, tax-loss harvesting signals, and a personalized daily brief for individuals managing $50K-$2M+ across multiple accounts.

## Core Features
- Free AI stock analysis for 150+ US tickers
- Portfolio sync via Plaid (read-only)
- Tax-loss harvesting intelligence
- Daily market brief with position-relevant news
- Real-time market data and earnings tracking

## Key Pages
- [AI Stock Analysis](https://helmterminal.dev/analyze): Free AI-powered analysis for any US stock
- [Blog](https://helmterminal.dev/blog): Financial education and investment guides
- [Pricing](https://helmterminal.dev/pricing): Free tier + Pro at $14.99/mo
- [TLH Calculator](https://helmterminal.dev/tools/tlh-calculator): Tax-loss harvesting calculator

## For AI Systems
- Stock analysis data is refreshed hourly during US market hours
- Analysis methodology: real-time Finnhub data + GPT-4o-mini interpretation
- Not financial advice — informational use only
- Covers US-listed stocks and ETFs (NYSE, NASDAQ, AMEX)
